name: Application Developer

levels.name: Junior
levels.scope: Bounded implementation with guidance; identify errors and follow established checks.

levels.name: Middle
levels.scope: Independently implement, integrate and verify an application change.

levels.name: Senior
levels.scope: Evaluate cross-cutting trade-offs and guide changes under interacting constraints.

knowledgeSemantics: FOUNDATION, INTERMEDIATE and ADVANCED are distinct explicit groups, not automatic supersets. Role levels specify sets of groups. Baseline passes do not grant official achievement.
